items.source: By default the built WebServiceTemplate uses the most suitable HTTP-based WebServiceMessageSender, call detectHttpMessageSender(false) if you prefer to keep the default. In a typical auto-configured Spring Boot application this builder is available as a bean and can be injected whenever a WebServiceTemplate is needed.
items.translation: 默认情况下，构建的WebServiceTemplate会使用最合适的基于 HTTP 的WebServiceMessageSender，如果您希望保留默认设置，请调用detectHttpMessageSender(false)。在典型的自动配置的 Spring Boot 应用程序中，该构建器可作为 Bean 提供，并在需要WebServiceTemplate时进行注入。

items.source: Sets the WebServiceMessageSenders that should be used with the WebServiceTemplate. Setting this value will replace any previously defined message senders, including the HTTP-based message sender, if any. Consider using additionalMessageSenders(WebServiceMessageSender...) to keep it with user-defined message senders.
items.translation: 设置与 WebServiceTemplate` 一起使用的 WebServiceMessageSenders`。设置此值将替换任何先前定义的消息发送器，包括基于 HTTP 的消息发送器（如果有）。请考虑使用 additionalMessageSenders(WebServiceMessageSender...) 将其与用户定义的消息发送器一起保留。

items.source: Sets the WebServiceMessageSenders that should be used with the WebServiceTemplate. Setting this value will replace any previously defined message senders, including the HTTP-based message sender, if any. Consider using additionalMessageSenders(Collection) to keep it with user-defined message senders.
items.translation: 设置与 WebServiceTemplate` 一起使用的 WebServiceMessageSenders`。设置此值将替换任何先前定义的消息发送器，包括基于 HTTP 的消息发送器（如果有）。请考虑使用 additionalMessageSenders(Collection) 将其与用户定义的消息发送器保留在一起。

items.source: Indicates whether the connection should be checked for error indicators (true), or whether these should be ignored (false).
items.translation: 指示是否应检查连接中的错误指示器（true），还是忽略这些指示器（false）。

items.source: Indicates whether the connection should be checked for fault indicators (true), or whether we should rely on the message only (false).
items.translation: 指示是否应检查连接中的故障指示器（true），还是仅依赖消息（false）。

items.source: Set if a suitable HTTP-based WebServiceMessageSender should be detected based on the classpath when one has not been specified. Default is true.
items.translation: 设置当未指定时，是否应基于类路径检测合适的基于 HTTP 的 `WebServiceMessageSender`。默认值为 true`。

items.source: Set the default URI to be used on operations that do not have a URI parameter. Typically, either this property is set, or setDestinationProvider(DestinationProvider), but not both.
items.translation: 将默认 URI 设置为在没有 URI 参数的操作中使用。通常，要么设置此属性，要么 setDestinationProvider(DestinationProvider)，但不能两者都使用。
